app.name: Steward AI
app.tagline: Generosity with transparency — from the moment someone gives to the moment they see the fruit.

give.title: Give to a fund
give.subtitle: Pick a fund and an amount. Checkout runs on PayPal; the order is created and captured on our server.
give.ineligible: PayPal is not available for this currency right now.
give.proposalNote: Nothing has been charged. Press the PayPal button below to confirm.

demo.banner: Demo environment · PayPal sandbox · No real money moves

entry.subtitle: Pick a role to explore {{church}}. No password, no sign-up.
entry.noPassword: This is a demo. Every role shares the same seeded church data, and you can switch at any time.

DONOR.title: Give as a member
DONOR.blurb: Give to a fund and see exactly what your gift accomplished.

TREASURER.title: Manage as treasurer
TREASURER.blurb: Review every gift, propose distributions, ask questions of the ledger.

PASTOR.title: Approve as pastor
PASTOR.blurb: The second key: nothing is paid out without your signature.

receipt.title: Thank you, {{name}}
receipt.subtitle: Your gift went through. Here is exactly what happened to it.
receipt.joins: Your gift joins {{total}} currently held in {{fund}}.
receipt.monthlyTitle: Your monthly gift is set up
receipt.monthlySubtitle: PayPal will charge this every month until you stop it.

error.title: Something broke on this page
error.body: This is a demo environment. Reloading usually fixes it.

chat.intro: Tell me what you would like to give, in English or Spanish.
chat.example1: I want to give $50 to missions
chat.example2: Quiero dar $100 al mes para construcción
chat.placeholder: Write what you would like to give…
chat.disclaimer: The assistant can only propose. Nothing is charged until you press the PayPal button.
chat.rateLimited: Too many requests on this demo. Try again in about {{minutes}} minutes.

dist.title: Distributions
dist.subtitle: The assistant proposes. The rules decide. Two people sign.
